# Prodhosh VS (thecodeguy)

> Prodhosh VS is a full-stack developer, product builder and founding engineer at BS Prep, based in Chennai, India. He builds end-to-end products with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase and PostgreSQL. This site, links.prodhosh.me, is the hub for all his links.

Contact: hello@prodhosh.me. Open to freelance work; a 15-minute call can be booked at https://cal.com/itzprodhosh/15min.
